tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nag po rim bzhi'i zur 'debs chos rje rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bas mdzad pa'i dpe ma dag pa'i zhu dag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung bzhin bgyis pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rje btsun dam pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /'khor lo sdom pa dbyer med la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /rim bzhi'i gdams ngag gsung bzhin bri/ /'dir slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i rim pa bzhi'i man ngag nyams su len par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la bsags sbyangs gnyis spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsol gdab kyi skabs su/ chos zab mo nyams su len pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po shes bya rgyud kyi rim pa la/ bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis rnal 'byor sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la mchod pa'i bar du bya ste/ gtso bo nas brtsams ste rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar 'dod na gsal/ mi gsal bar 'dod na mi gsal gyi bar du bsgom pa sngon du song nas/ khams gsum snod bcud srung 'khor nas gzhal yas khang gi bar du bsdu/ 'khor gyi lha rnams phyogs g.yon bskor gyi sna bug g.yon nas bsdus te snying kha'i aṃ la bstim/ de bzhin du mtshams g.yas bskor gyi gong ltar ro/ /yum yang shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs rkyang ma nas lte ba'i dmar cha la thim pas/ mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar gyur pas 'khor lo drug gsal gdab par bya ste/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po gdeng kha gyen du bstan pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ lte ba'i nang bskor 'dab ma brgyad la yi ge dgod pa kyai rdo rje bzhin no/

/phyi bskor la nang bskor gyi 'dab ma brgyad po re re las/ 'dab chung bdun bdun du gyes pas 'dab ma lnga bcu rtsa drug la a li bcu drug g.yon bskor/ ka li so bzhi g.yas bskor/ de'i bar gyi 'dab ma drug la a ī u āe o aṃ rnams dgod de/ yig 'bru rnams khog dmar po mgo gyen bstan no/ /snying khar phyogs bzhir bhrum̐ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir ya ra la wa mgrin par nang bskor la oṃ ā i au/ phyi bskor 'dab chung bcu gnyis la ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ bzhi spangs pas bcu gnyis so/ /snying kha dang / mgrin pa'i yig 'bru rnams kha dog sngon po dang / dmar po'o/ spyi bor a li phrag gnyis bkod par bshad kyang / 'dir gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi dgongs pa haṃ gcig po bsgom gsungs/ de nas rtsa gsum gsal gdab ste/ g.yas ro ma kha gyen du blta ba kha dog dmar po'i nang du yas rim gyi a li dkar po mgo thur bstan dang / ka li dmar po mgo gyen bstan spel ba'i mthar hūm̐ dang phaṭ dang bcas pas bkag de bzhin du g.yon rkyang ma la kha dog yi ge rnams yas rim gyis go ldog ste shes so/ /rtsa dbu ma shin tu cha phra ba rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam kha dog dmar po ste gsum ka spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mngon sum du mthong ba'o/ /de ltar byas nas rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum dang bstun nas/ rtsa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab nas bsgom gsungs/ gnyis pa nyams len sngags kyi rim pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas yum thim pa'i bar gong bzhin byas nas/ rlung mar rtse sprad pa ste 'og sgo 'byed btsum lan 'ga' byas pa'i tha ma la bsdams pas/ lte ba'i aṃ lcags sbud pas bus pa ltar dmar ngar gyis song bar bsam/ rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun nas 'khor lo rtsa yig dang bcas pa mas rim gyis gsal gdab/

nang du 'jug pa dang yas kyis gsal gdab ste/ steng rlung tshir gyis mnan la lte ba'i aṃ la bstims te dmigs pa der gtad nas bsgom/ mi thub pa na dal bus btang / de ltar yang nas yang du bsgoms pas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang / dngos su me snying kha'i bar du 'bar ba snyam byed pa 'byung ste sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ 'og rlung drag tu bskums pas aṃ las me 'bar te lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru rnams bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song ste 'khor lo gong ma gnyis kyang de bzhin du bsregs te/ me rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus pas mdzod spu gnad kyi sgo phye nas/ sna bug g.yas nas byung ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de pa dpag tu med pa bsgom/ de yang sbyang ba'i phyir/ dang po gcig la bslab ste/ de pa'i shangs kyi bu kha g.yon byin pa g.yon nas zhugs/ gnad kyi sgo phye ste rlung de dag bya/ drod kyi rang bzhin can des/ de pa'i 'khor lo rnams rim gyis zhu btul byas pa'i byang chub kyi bdud rtsi shangs kyi bu kha g.yas nas khyer te 'ong pas/ rang gi spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo nas lte ba'i 'khor lo'i bar khengs/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog des aṃ drag tu 'bar te me shin tu cha phra ba glog gi zer ma lta bus rtsa dbu ma kha phye nas snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / mgrin pa'i oṃ yang zhen thogs med par bcom nas/ haṃ la phog pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pas oṃ dang / hūm̐ ches gsal bar byas/ me dang gnyis 'bar 'dzag lte ba'i aṃ la nas gang tsam du reg pa'am/ yang na aṃ la thim pa la sems gtad de steng rlung tshir gyis mnan nas ci rigs par bsgom gsungs/ mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ lus 'phar g.yo dang / 'dar ba/ ngag ku co 'don pa la sogs pa 'byung bas re zhig byung rgyal du bskyangs pas zhi/ des ma zhi na yi ge mgo bcad de/ haṃ las bdud rtsi 'dzag 'phro bcad de bsgom/ des kyang ma zhi na/

stod kha yed du bsam pa ste snying kha yan chad hang gdangs su bsgom/ des kyang ma zhi na/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa yin pas snang ba thams cad sems su dran par byas pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa skye ba ye shes kyi rim pa ni/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ las phab pa'i byang chub kyi sems dbu ma'i lam nas byung nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtser phab/ thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa la sems gtad de bde ba skyes skyes su bsgom mo/ /de nas mas brtan bcu drug tu bsgom pa dkyus bzhin no/ /bzhi pa gsang ba'i rim pa ni/ rlung bsgom pa ste/ 'di la gnyis/ gsang ba'i rim pa dngos dang / gegs bsal ba'o/ /dang po yum thim pa'i bar gong bzhin byas nas/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i shangs bug gnyis kyi bar gyi ka ba med pa'i sgo nga lta bu stong sang nge ba gcig bsam/ de nas rlung phyir 'gro ba nas/ sna rtser ri sna la smug pa 'khyil ba ltar 'khyil gyis byung bar bsam/ nang du 'jug pa na sib kyis thim par bsgom pa ste/ rlung srog rtsol 'ba' zhig bsgom pas smig sgyu la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ smin phrag tu thig le la sems gtad pa sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis su med pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba'i rim par 'dus pas zur du ma byas kyang chog gtum mo lam rdzogs ltar du byed na/ chos thams cad sems dang sems las byung bar 'dus pas/ sems kyi byung tshor thams cad mi dmigs par bsgom mo/ /de yang gang dang gnyis su med na/ gsal ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i mtshan nyid can de bzhin du rig stong gnyis med/ bde stong gnyis med/ gang du'ang 'dzin pa med par bsgom gsungs so/ /rim pa bzhi pa 'di rtsa rgyud kyi le'u so lnga pa nas chos kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa drang don du bshad pas/ sbyin sreg dang / nges don du bshad pas rim bzhi ston pa yin no/

/de'ang rim pa bzhi'i dang po rtsa dang / gnyis pa yi ge dang / gsum pa khams bdud rtsi dang / bzhi pa snying po ye shes rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i gdams ngag yin gsungs/ de dag gi 'jug pas lam tshogs sbyor gnyis chod nas/ bla ma dang yi dam gyis lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya la tshul bzhin brten nas/ spros bcas spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas rtsa khams rnams dbu mar thim nas nang gi sa lam bgrod de kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur gsungs/ 'di dag ni dmigs rkang dang / chos rje rin po ches gsung 'bur dod cung zad zin pa rnams bris pa yin la/ rgyas bshad rnams rim bzhi lam slong dang gtum mo lam rdzogs nas gsungs pa bzhin mdzad do/ /'di bris dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /rje btsun yab sras zhabs bsten nas/ /lam mchog 'di dang mi 'bral zhing / /he ru ka dpal myur thob shog /nag po rim bzhi'i zur 'debs chos rje rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bas mdzad pa'i dpe ma dag pa rnams sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun bla ma mus pa'i gsung dang mthun par zhu dag bgyis so/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ nag po rim bzhi'i zur 'debs chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bas mdzad pa'i dpe ma dag pa'i zhu dag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
